recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current specification already carries the approved ordering rule; this source change fixes the remaining metadata inconsistency introduced during the original application.
issue_request: FHIR-28578 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking FHIR-core Appointment to include an invariant so Appointment.end cannot be before Appointment.start when the dates are provided.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit 42ae2bc6afe1ad0f2afcd922884f14aa6c5e74ce, which added app-5 with the correct human text and FHIRPath expression. The initial hunk also copied a source URI of http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Questionnaire, leaving incorrect constraint metadata on the Appointment invariant.
additional_context: Appointment is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The originating Zulip thread and PA January 2021 WGM minutes both support adding the Appointment-specific start/end ordering invariant, and no discovered later decision reversed that rule. Later Appointment cleanup history reformatted or simplified the invariant but left the copied Questionnaire source URI unchanged.
reconciliation: Changed source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml so app-5 declares http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Appointment as its source. The existing invariant expression and conditions on Appointment.start and Appointment.end were left intact.
source_changes: source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml: changed the app-5 constraint source URI from Questionnaire to Appointment.

related_jiras.note: A later Appointment recurring-appointments commit reformatted the invariant but left the copied source URI unchanged.
A later invariant cleanup removed legacy xpath details but did not correct the source URI.
